title: Federal Employees Benevolent Fund and Group Insurance Amendment Act 2010

sections.shortTitle: Federal Employees Benevolent Fund and Group Insurance Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XX OF 2010
ACT XX OF 2010
FEDERAL EMPLOYEES BENEVOLENT FUND AND
GROUP INSURANCE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the Federal Employees
Benevolent Fund and Group Insurance Act, 1969
[Gazatte of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I,
4th December, 2010]
The
following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament)
received the assent of the President on 30th November, 2010 and is hereby
published for general information:--
Whereas
it is expedient further to amend the Federal Employees Benevolent Fund and
Group Insurance Act, 1969 (II of 1969), for the purposes hereinafter appearing:
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Federal Employees
Benevolent Fund and Group Insurance (Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2)
It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on
and from the first day of July, 2009.
